Hi! New hire here (day 4). What's our home office setup budget? I need a monitor, chair, and a desk. The public handbook page on equipment redirects me to an internal page I can't open yet because my Okta access is still pending.

Felipe Costa (People Ops)  3:26 PM
Welcome Riya! The current home office equipment stipend for new hires is **$750 USD total** (was $500 before February 2026) and it covers monitor, chair, desk, keyboard, mouse, headset, webcam, and ergonomic accessories. Here's the flow:

1. Wait until Okta provisions (should be by end of day 2) — you'll get an email from it-help@gitlab.com.
2. Log into **Navan** and use the "Home Office Setup" expense category for reimbursements, or submit a request for a virtual card in advance through the **Home Office Stipend Form** linked in #new_team_members pinned messages.
3. You have until day 90 of employment to spend it. Leftover budget doesn't roll over.
4. Questions → expenses@gitlab.com or ping #expenses-help.

Exactly what I needed, thanks!

Felipe Costa (People Ops)  3:29 PM
One more thing — software purchases (Notion, Figma, etc.) don't come out of this budget. Those go through the Individual Use Software process via Zip.

Kenji Walsh  8:42 AM
Kind of a weird question — my official start date is Monday May 26, which is Memorial Day in the US. Does my onboarding actually start that day, or does it push to Tuesday? I don't want to miss the TaNewKi call or Day 1 stuff.

Linh Tran (People Ops)  9:03 AM
Great question Kenji — this comes up every federal holiday. Policy: **if your official start date lands on a US federal holiday (or a GitLab Family & Friends Day), your onboarding kicks off the next business day** and your start-date paperwork is backdated to the holiday. Here's what that means for you:

- Payroll still records Monday May 26 as Day 1 (you get paid for the holiday).
- Your **onboarding issue becomes active on Tuesday May 27** — that's when you start the checklist, meet your buddy, and do Slack intros.
- Your **TaNewKi call is unaffected** — those happen 1–2 weeks before start date on a rolling Thursday schedule so you should've already attended one.
- Your **Day 2 Access Request** (the Okta / tooling one owned by IT) gets auto-generated on Wednesday May 28 instead of Tuesday.

Kenji Walsh  9:05 AM
Clear, thanks. So effectively I get a free day off before I start.

Linh Tran (People Ops)  9:06 AM
Exactly 🙂. Enjoy the long weekend.

metadata.title: What if my start date is a US federal holiday?
